sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "affected_region"."Storm_ID" AS e, SUM("affected_region"."Number_city_affected") AS m1 FROM "affected_region" GROUP BY "affected_region"."Storm_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

why: total of cities affected by storm in region per storm (by Storm_ID) (additive)
share of the all total of total of cities affected by storm in region (all level)
gap to the all average of total of cities affected by storm in region (all level)
